Today, Democratic candidate for Arizona’s 8th Congressional District Bernadette Greene-Placentia was sexually assaulted by two men while repairing campaign signs; soldiers seriously wounded in an Iranian drone strike say the military’s medical system failed them; a Massachusetts man has pled guilty to selling plutonium from Russia; the Trump administration is blocking international election monitors for the first time in two decades; a federal judge has ordered the Kennedy Center board to unseal a renovation report the Trump administration has been trying to keep secret; plus Allison and Dana deliver your Good News.
